An adventurer who died in Helheim, near Svargrond, left some useful items behind. Go down three floors of the Helheim dungeon, full of undead, and look for his pile of bones to get a {item:Berserk Potion}, 2 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}, a {item:Shard} and 3 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}.
An adventurer who died in Helheim left behind some useful items.
Access to Helheim: {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} up to the mission *The Secret of Helheim*.
Health potions and a good weapon against undead
50 gp for each trip with {npc:Buddel} (there and back).
To save time, do this quest at the same time as the *The Secret of Helheim* mission of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest}.

From **Svargrond**, head **south** and find {npc:Buddel} on his boat. Ask him for a trip to Helheim: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:helheim} and confirm with {key:yes}. It costs 50 gp and you land at Buddel's boat in {wiki:Helheim} ({coord:32465,31174,7}).

Buddel is always drunk and may take you to the wrong place. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right destination (he keeps the ring instead of the 50 gp); say {key:no} when he asks for it, or use the ring in the slot if you don't want to lose it.
On arriving in Helheim, head **southeast** from Buddel's boat and climb the mountain. Then head **northeast** and go down the **2 ramps** to enter the dungeon.
Route on Helheim (1/3): blue = start, green = destination
Map of the island of Helheim
2. Go down to the pile of bones
On the first floor, go to the **south** end of the cave and go down the ramp.
Head **west** until you find another staircase and go down.
On this floor there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and {creature:Mummy|Mummies}.
Head **north** until you find a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)}. Open the pile of bones to receive the reward.

On this floor there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}. Next to the bones there can be up to 3 Bonebeasts and a Demon Skeleton at the same time.
Map of the Berserk Potion Quest

Go back the same way: on the 3rd floor return **south** to the stairs and go up; on the 2nd floor go **east** to the ramp and go up; on the 1st floor go **north** and climb the **2 ramps** to the surface. Then head **southwest**, go down the mountain and return **northwest** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} and {key:yes} to return to the dock south of Svargrond.
